ext_cfg_ai_api_key: AI API key (Ollama local service can leave it empty). Deprecated: the extension automatically migrates this value into encrypted SecretStorage and clears this setting. User-level only; not overridable per workspace.
ext_cfg_ai_api_key_deprecation: The key is now managed by the extension's secure storage (SecretStorage); any value entered here is automatically migrated and cleared on next use.
ext_cfg_ai_base_url: AI API base URL (when empty, uses the selected provider's default, e.g. DeepSeek: https://api.deepseek.com/v1; user-level only, not overridable per workspace)
ext_cfg_ai_model: AI model name (when empty, uses the selected provider's default model)
ext_cfg_ai_provider: AI provider identifier: openai / deepseek / qwen / glm / ollama / anthropic / gemini / custom (user-level only, not overridable per workspace)
ext_cfg_ai_system_prompt: Custom system prompt. When empty, it is generated automatically from the current language pack. To keep it custom while still auto-injecting the dialect vocabulary on language-pack switch, place the placeholder `{{dialect_tables}}` in the text (it is replaced at runtime with the current pack's dialect-table prompt); without the placeholder, it fully overrides the built-in prompt (not updated on language switch, which may mismatch language and vocabulary).
ext_cfg_ai_temperature: AI sampling temperature (0–2, default 0.1; teaching scenarios prefer stable output)
ext_cfg_auto_convert_fullwidth: Automatically convert full-width symbols to half-width when typed in code regions (outside strings and comments)
ext_cfg_check_updates: After startup, check GitHub Releases for a newer version (at most once a day) and notify when one is found
ext_cfg_hide_generated: Hide transpile output: writes `**/*.rs` and `**/*.rs.bak` into the workspace `files.exclude` (they disappear from the Explorer; removed on close to restore visibility). Intended for projects where `.zh` and other dialect files are the source and `.rs` is transpile output; keep it off when the workspace itself is a Rust source repo (`.rs` is the source). Toggle quickly with the 'i18n: Show/Hide Transpile Output' command.
ext_cfg_language_pack: The language pack currently in use
ext_cfg_language_pack_path: Language pack directory path (leave empty for the default)
ext_cfg_rzc_path: Path to the rzc command-line tool (absolute, workspace-relative, or a command name on PATH)
ext_cfg_server_path: Path to the i18n-rust-lsp executable (absolute, workspace-relative, or a command name on PATH)
ext_cmd_ai_generate: AI Generate Dialect Code (auto rzc check & fix)
